name: Catastro GPS API
description:
Public API of Catastro GPS / Parcel GPS. Spanish data comes from our own copy of the Dirección General del Catastro (dataSource `clone`/`local_clone`) and, when the copy does not have a finca, from the Catastro live (`catastro`). Attribution to the Dirección General del Catastro is mandatory and is returned in `attribution` where it applies.

## Pricing and quota

Plan prices are per month, in euros, **VAT included**. The quota belongs to your organisation and is shared by all its API keys.

| Plan | Price per month (VAT included) | Units per month | Requests per minute | Extra units, per 1,000 (prepaid balance, plus 21% VAT) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | 0 € | 250 | 10 | 10.00 € |
| Developer | 19 € | 5,000 | 60 | 5.00 € |
| Startup | 49 € | 15,000 | 120 | 4.00 € |
| Growth | 99 € | 50,000 | 300 | 2.50 € |
| Enterprise | from 300 € | by contract | 300, or more by contract | by contract |

**What counts as a unit.** Only successful (2xx) answers with data cost units:

| Call | Units |
|---|---|
| Parcel by reference, by coordinates, `/solar`, `/agro`, `/score`, `/market` | 1 per answer; 0 when the answer carries no data (`disponible: false` from `/market` or `/solar`, an empty `/agro`, a `/score` without data) |
| `GET /api/search/address/candidates` | 1 when it returns candidates; none found is a 404 and free |
| `GET /api/catastro/{refcat14}/units` | 1 per unit (dwelling) served in that page, minimum 1 |
| `POST /api/catastro/compare` | 1 per parcel found (0 to 3); free if none is found |
| Any other 2xx answer | 1 |
| 304 Not Modified, 300, 4xx, 5xx | free |

**Reset.** The quota resets at 00:00 UTC on day 1 of every calendar month (`X-Quota-Reset`). Unused units do not carry over to the next month.

**When the quota runs out.** Requests keep working and each extra unit is charged to your organisation's prepaid balance at your plan's price above. Top-ups are made in the developer portal (https://parcelgps.com/app/developer): from 5 € to 1,000 € net per top-up, plus 21% VAT shown on the invoice. With the quota used up and no balance left (or overage paused in the portal), the API answers **429 `KEY_AUTH_004`** and nothing is charged; there is never a debt. Current overage prices: `GET /api/api-overage/pricing`.

**Rate limit.** Per API key and minute, by plan (table above). Going over answers 429 `KEY_RATE_002` with `Retry-After`.

Error bodies always carry a stable machine code in `code` and an English text in `error`.

## Coverage by country

What each country answers today (measured against production on 1 October 2026; address search with five real addresses per country). Every country returns the reference, the GPS point (`latitud`, `longitud`), the outline (`poligono`) and the area (`superficieParcela`), by reference and by coordinates, unless the row says otherwise. `availableFields` in each response says which of the optional fields that response really carries.

| Country | `country` | By reference | By coordinates | By address (`/search/address/candidates`) | Extra data |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spain, common territory | `ES` | yes | yes | yes (CartoCiudad) | address, use, class, built area, year, units/dwellings; `/units` |
| Spain, Basque Country / Navarre | `PV` / `NA` | yes | yes | yes, with `country=ES` | address, use, built area, year; `/units` (foral copy, no participation coefficient) |
| France | `FR` | yes | yes | yes (Base Adresse Nationale) | by reference also use, built area, year, dwellings and floors (BDNB) |
| Italy | `IT` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | municipality, province |
| Germany (15 of 16 Länder, **no Bavaria**) | `DE` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap), not in Bavaria | municipality, Land |
| Austria | `AT` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | municipality, use |
| Netherlands | `NL` | yes | yes | yes (PDOK Locatieserver) | municipality |
| Belgium | `BE` | yes | yes (3-7 s, slow source) | yes (Digitaal Vlaanderen + OpenStreetMap), 5-15 s | — |
| Poland | `PL` | yes | yes | yes (GUGiK) | municipality, voivodeship |
| Switzerland | `CH` | yes | yes, except where the canton publishes no parcels (e.g. Vaud) | yes (swisstopo) | canton |
| Czechia | `CZ` | yes | yes | yes (RÚIAN) | — |
| Denmark | `DK` | yes | yes | yes (Dataforsyningen) | municipality |
| Norway | `NO` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | municipality |
| Finland | `FI` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | — |
| Estonia | `EE` | yes | yes | yes (In-ADS) | municipality |
| Latvia | `LV` | yes; bare digits need `?country=LV` | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | — |
| Lithuania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Bulgaria | `LT`, `SI`, `SK`, `BG` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap; Cyrillic accepted in `BG`) | municipality in `SI` |
| Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Iceland | `LU`, `LI`, `IS` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap) | — |
| Greece | `GR` | only with `?country=GR` | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap; Greek script) | — |
| Cyprus | `CY` | yes | yes | yes (OpenStreetMap), low `confianza`: few house numbers mapped | — |
| Portugal | `PT` | yes | partial: the cadastre does not cover Lisbon, Porto or Coimbra | partial, same limit; the DGT source is often down | municipality |
| Ireland | `IE` | only with `?country=` (the numeric SP_ID) | partial | partial (OpenStreetMap) | county |
| United Kingdom | `UK` | no | Scotland only | Scotland only (OpenStreetMap) | — |
| Croatia | `HR` | no: there is no open cadastre | **ARKOD agricultural parcels only** (Croatian Paying Agency), not cadastral parcels, and not nationwide (Zagreb and Rijeka have none) | no (422) | — |
| Sweden | `SE` | agricultural blocks | agricultural blocks | no (422): no parcels at urban addresses | land use |

Not covered: Hungary, Romania and the rest. A reference from a country without coverage answers **422 `CNV_COVERAGE`**; bare digits that could belong to several countries answer **300 `CNV_AMBIGUOUS`** with the candidate countries — repeat the call with `?country=`. `/units` and dwellings are Spain only (common territory, Basque Country and Navarra).

The analysis endpoints (`/solar`, `/agro`, `/score`) cover `ES`, `PV`, `NA`, `PT`, `FR`, `IT` and `DE`; other countries answer 422 `CNV_COVERAGE`. Human-readable coverage and pricing: https://parcelgps.com/developers.
